metadata.title: Yoten Labs | AI-native product studio
metadata.description: Yoten Labs designs, builds, and operates AI-native software for teams that need clarity, trust, and measurable outcomes.

hero.title: AI-native products, built for scale and reliability.
hero.description: Yoten Labs designs, builds, and operates software where AI is the core system behind the experience and the operation. We combine product thinking, production engineering, and disciplined delivery for B2C and B2B teams.

panel.label: Positioning
panel.description: We prioritize clarity, trust, and measurable outcomes across data workflows, retrieval and generation pipelines, guardrails, evaluation, monitoring, and scalable delivery.

metrics.label: Core systems designed around AI from day one.
Real products with operational controls and clear ownership.
Evaluation, guardrails, and reliability built into the stack.
Delivery tied to measurable improvement, not vanity metrics.

yoten.label: Yoten
yoten.description: Yōten (要点) means 'key point' or 'essentials', a reminder to focus on what matters and ship with clarity.

whatWeDo.title: What we do
whatWeDo.description: The MVP stays focused, but the core system is built for production pressure from the start.

items.title: AI-native product development
items.description: Product strategy, UX, and engineering shaped around AI as the operating system, not a feature layer.

items.title: RAG and generation pipelines
items.description: Retrieval, orchestration, prompt design, and generation flows designed for useful outputs and stable operations.

items.title: Evaluation and monitoring
items.description: We instrument quality, latency, cost, and behavior so teams can improve with evidence.

items.title: Guardrails and safety
items.description: Controls for permissions, risky outputs, policy boundaries, and predictable user-facing behavior.

items.title: Cost, quotas, reliability
items.description: Quota enforcement, fallback paths, and operational limits that keep AI features economically sane.

items.title: B2C and B2B delivery
items.description: Consumer and enterprise products delivered with clear scope, reliable execution, and room to scale.

howWeWork.title: How we work
howWeWork.description: The work stays practical: align, build, evaluate, and operate with the same level of discipline.

steps.title: Align on outcomes
steps.description: We define the user problem, the operational target, and the measurable result before building.

steps.title: Build the core system
steps.description: We implement the workflows, retrieval and generation layers, interfaces, and controls that matter.

steps.title: Evaluate and harden
steps.description: We pressure-test prompts, outputs, latency, quotas, and edge cases before widening exposure.

steps.title: Ship and operate
steps.description: We launch with monitoring, ownership, and iteration loops that keep the product improving.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Current products being developed inside Yoten Labs.

cards.name: WearingDaily
cards.description: Consumer fashion app for fast outfit generation using deterministic formulas, curated catalog completion, saved looks, packs twice a week, optional photo try-on, and video try-on as a paid premium feature.

cards.name: Live-Drills
cards.tagline: AI coaching for real training practice
cards.description: AI training platform with video/voice avatar and guided role-play sessions for CX, sales/negotiation, and procedures/onboarding. Includes rounds, coaching pauses, re-runs, and bilingual coach responses (pt-BR/en-US). Uses customer manuals, documents, videos, and images as training source, supports media playback during sessions, runs on LiveKit Cloud for real-time events, and ships with multi-tenant + RBAC architecture, plan/feature controls, and prompt quality evaluation workflows.

cards.name: Platform Health.ai
cards.description: Multi-tenant healthcare operations platform with RBAC, documents, scheduling, billing events, and real-time session flows designed for clarity, trust, and measurable outcomes.

items.question: Do you only build MVPs?
items.answer: No. We can shape the MVP, but we build the core system with production constraints in mind.

items.question: Do you work with enterprise teams?
items.answer: Yes. We build for both B2C and B2B contexts, including multi-tenant and operational platforms.

items.question: Do you handle reliability and controls?
items.answer: Yes. Guardrails, monitoring, quotas, and cost controls are part of the delivery scope.

items.question: Can you work on voice and real-time products?
items.answer: Yes. Real-time sessions, roleplay systems, and voice-first experiences are active areas for us.

metadata.title: Yoten Labs Pitch Deck | AI-native product studio
metadata.description: Investor-focused pitch deck for Yoten Labs, an AI-native product studio building reliable software systems around AI.

hero.title: Yoten Labs builds AI-native products where intelligence is the operating core.
hero.description: We design, build, and operate reliable AI systems for consumer and enterprise workflows, combining product strategy, production engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and disciplined delivery.

signals.label: Products designed around intelligence from day one.
Architecture, monitoring, cost controls, and reliability built into delivery.
Multiple product surfaces moving through focused build cycles.

problem.title: AI features are not enough.
problem.description: Most companies are adding AI as a thin layer on top of existing workflows. The result is inconsistent quality, unclear ownership, unmanaged costs, and limited trust in the final user experience.
points: Teams need systems that can reason, retrieve, generate, and act with operational controls.
Reliability, evaluation, and safety must be part of the product architecture.
The gap is not access to models; it is shipping useful AI workflows into production.

opportunity.title: The next wave of software will be built around AI as infrastructure.
opportunity.description: Consumer and enterprise products are shifting from static interfaces to adaptive workflows powered by retrieval, generation, agents, real-time media, and automation. Teams that ship trustworthy AI-native systems will compound faster.
points: Vertical products can become more useful when intelligence is embedded in the core workflow.
Enterprise buyers need proof that AI systems can be governed, measured, and operated.
Studios that combine product judgment with production engineering can move faster than traditional delivery models.

solution.title: Yoten Labs builds the core system, not the demo layer.
solution.description: We connect strategy, UX, architecture, model orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, and operations into one delivery motion. The outcome is software that can launch, learn, and scale responsibly.
points: Product framing starts with user outcomes and operational constraints.
Engineering includes data flows, prompts, tools, permissions, and fallback paths.
Launch plans include monitoring, quality checks, and ownership from the start.

differentiation.title: The advantage is disciplined AI delivery.
differentiation.description: Yoten Labs focuses on the production details that make AI products usable: evaluation loops, guardrails, cost controls, latency awareness, and pragmatic architecture.
points: We keep scope focused while designing the core system for production pressure.
We treat quality, safety, and reliability as product requirements.
We build for both consumer polish and enterprise operating standards.

businessModel.title: A studio model with paths to owned assets.
businessModel.description: The company can generate value through product builds, strategic partnerships, and proprietary products developed inside the studio. This v1 deck intentionally avoids revenue projections or fundraising numbers.
points: Service and product-build work creates near-term market contact and technical leverage.
Internal products create reusable systems, patterns, and intellectual property.
Partnerships can turn proven workflows into scalable product opportunities.

roadmap.title: Build focused products, validate workflows, compound reusable systems.
roadmap.description: The roadmap is qualitative: ship focused product surfaces, prove core workflows, strengthen reliability layers, and expand the portfolio where usage and partner demand justify it.
points: Near term: sharpen product positioning and launch-ready flows.
Mid term: deepen evaluation, monitoring, and reusable AI infrastructure.
Long term: expand owned products and partner-led distribution.

team.title: A lean team built for product clarity and engineering depth.
team.description: Yoten Labs operates as a focused product and engineering studio, prioritizing clear ownership, fast iteration, and architecture decisions that reduce long-term friction.
points: Small teams keep communication direct and delivery accountable.
Architecture choices favor KISS, DRY, maintainability, and production visibility.
Execution balances product taste with measurable technical quality.

products.title: Products in development
products.description: The current portfolio demonstrates how Yoten Labs applies the same AI-native delivery principles across consumer, training, and healthcare operations contexts.

cta.title: Let's discuss the opportunity behind reliable AI-native products.
cta.description: For investor, partner, or strategic conversations, contact Yoten Labs directly. This public deck intentionally avoids sensitive financial details.
